verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for a SaaS CDP like mParticle, since its client SDKs or platform could be published under an open license, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any source code released under an open license. The 'Client SDKs' item gives only a title with no repository or license, and the downloadable Events API OpenAPI spec is an interface description, not source code under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
